_comment: Sample npm artifact manifest. The `integrity` field is npm-native (sha512 base64) and is what `npm view express@4.18.2 dist.integrity` returns. We carry both: sha256 (universal, what our pipeline computes) and integrity (npm-native, what npm install verifies). Both must match before install proceeds.
name: express

metadata.fetchCommand: npm view express@4.18.2 dist.integrity && npm view express@4.18.2 dist.tarball
metadata.note: When the populated manifest is signed, the sha256 and the integrity must both verify on download. If they disagree, the install aborts — that disagreement would indicate either a corrupted download or a registry compromise.
